name: job-search-assistant
description: Find relevant jobs, tailor truthful applications, plan referrals, and pick up where you left off with a saved local workspace.

interface.longDescription:
Move from "I should apply" to a clear next step. Find relevant roles, turn your real experience into focused applications, and keep your job search moving without starting over in every chat.

Job Search Assistant brings discovery, resume tailoring, referrals, applications, and follow-ups into one local workspace. Describe the help you need in plain language, whether you are starting a search, managing several opportunities, or returning to unfinished applications.

Find opportunities that fit. Search LinkedIn Jobs based on your experience, target roles, location, and dealbreakers, with employer career pages and web research for additional context. Indeed is optional. Already have a job link? Bring it in for a focused review. Compare requirements with your background, see strengths and gaps, and save promising roles without duplicate tracker entries.

Prepare an application with a clear story. Tailor your resume and application materials using your actual experience. Connect relevant projects and skills to the role, identify missing evidence, and prepare answers for your review. Unknown details stay as questions for you; the workflow does not invent credentials, achievements, or experience.

Make referrals and follow-ups easier to manage. Research potential contacts, draft outreach, coordinate referral steps, and track replies and next actions. Review the recipient, exact message, and any attachments before anything is sent. A referral conversation and a confirmed referral are tracked separately.

Know what deserves attention next. Review priorities, application status, referral deadlines, and pending work in your tracker. Ask for a short list of useful next steps, focus on a specific role, or set a limit such as "I have 15 minutes" or "prepare three applications." Prepare-only requests keep the work local for your review.

Pick up where you left off. Your selected workspace keeps the tracker, resume sources, preferences, application materials, and progress between local chats. Say "continue my job search" to resume from saved records. Plugin updates and removal leave those working files in place, and you control their retention and deletion.

You stay in control. Review and explicitly approve uploads, messages, connection requests, application submissions, and public profile changes. The assistant checks relevant browser accounts and pauses blocked browser steps while continuing useful local preparation.

Designed for Codex and ChatGPT Work sessions with access to your local files. Browser tasks also need supported browser tools and sign-in to the relevant service. Installation alone does not grant file or account access. Cloud-only sessions cannot read your computer's workspace without local access. This plugin provides instructions and templates; it has no publisher-operated server, background service, or cross-device synchronization.

Local storage does not mean offline processing: information read by the assistant is processed through OpenAI and any services you choose to use. Job availability can change, and no interview or job-placement outcome is guaranteed. Independent project by Farzam Hejazi; not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI, LinkedIn, Indeed, or employers.
defaultPrompt: Help me set up my job search using my resume, target roles, location, and dealbreakers.
Find 3 roles that fit my experience, explain the gaps, and save the best matches to my tracker.
Continue my job search: show what needs attention and help prepare my next application.

publication.release_notes: 0.1.3 expands the listing with practical workflow examples, clearer capabilities, and more useful starter prompts. The public privacy policy and local persistence behavior are unchanged.
